summary: The honest terminal is ep 119 → ch 273, and MU's pin is REDUNDANT (G56): MU's own prose already says 'Vol 23, Chap 273 (1983 EP 119) Some differences' — the refusal is a PARSE artifact, not a data conflict (parseCoverageAll only trusts an EP number when the text holds exactly one Vol/Chap pair, and MU's text holds three: 273 / 387 / 465, so the pin defaults to aired_episodes 137, a T6 filler row). Target rows 116-119 adapt exactly ONE tankōbon — volume 23, chs 264-273 — the conclusion of the 夢の超人タッグ編 (Shueisha's own vol-23 blurb: 『夢の超人タッグ編完結!!』; the fandom volume list gives vol 23 = 264-273; ja-WP gives the arc as chs 209-273). Ep 119B 光り輝くトロフィー!の巻 is ch 273 栄光のトロフィー!!の巻 — the arc's and the anime's last adapted chapter — so the post-series continue is ch 274 (C5), the first chapter of the キン肉星王位争奪編 (chs 274-387), which THIS series never touches (the 1991 sequel anime adapts it; MU independently prints 'Vol 24, Chap 274 (Scramble for the Throne)' as that anime's start). Rows 120-121 (and 122-137) take NO anchor under A1: they are the two anime-original arcs ザ・サイコー超人の挑戦編 and 地獄の極悪超人編 (T6, already ruled filler) — ja-WP and the ja fandom both label them アニメオリジナル, and Toei's own synopses (a luxury liner, the Psycho Chojin, Yama Khan) have no counterpart anywhere in chs 274+; the hunt for grafted source pages came up empty, so no T28 retype is proposed. Two surprises: (1) the whole target block sits inside an anime-original FRAME — ja fandom records that Dream-Tag Part 2 warps the ring from Tournament Mountain to a Pyramid Ring in Hokkaido which then flies into space toward the trophy planet (Toei ep 119 verbatim: 「ピラミッドリングのある北海道は、現在宇宙空間に浮かんでいる」) — canon content, divergent staging, so a divergence annotation rather than a retype; (2) our air_date column is defective for rows 38, 87 and 90-119 (duplicated dates at 38/39 and 89/90 push everything a week early and drop the 1985-12-29 airing) — the four target rows' dates are all one week off.

anchors.note: 116A 見た!キン肉マンの素顔の巻 = ch 264 覆面狩り予告達成!?の巻 (fandom arc chain: ch 264 = the Muscle Brothers swap places under the ring and swap masks; Toei: 「マスクを奪われたキン肉マンの様子がおかしい。現れた素顔は、誰もが驚くべきものだった」); 116B ネプチューンキング出現の巻 = ch 265 完璧の秘密!!の巻. A10 START: Toei's official synopsis opens ep 116 with the Mask The End hold connecting and the mask peeling — the climax of ch 263 (ep 115B's title chapter) finished here, not a ≤5-page recap sliver, so ch 263 is the START and the 115/116 straddle is annotated (same shape as the stored eps 45/46/47 partial{118-119} lattice). Volume 23 per A13/the END chapter.

117A くし刺し!テリーマンの巻 = ch 266 孤独の戦士!!の巻 — two independent sources on the same beat: the fandom arc chain cites ch 266 for 'Terryman is then knocked out of the ring onto the spikes, where he is incapacitated', Toei's synopsis for ep 117 says 「キン肉マンを救うため、テリーマンは場外の剣に刺されて息絶えた」 (that pin is HIGH). 117B 奇跡を呼ぶ友情パワーの巻 = ch 267 磁力には磁力を!!の巻 (the lone Kinnikuman answering Magnet Power); ch 268 完璧なる友情!!の巻 is held back to ep 118, where Toei has Neptuneman start to doubt the Perfects. A4 END = 267 is the derived boundary — medium.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 268-270 (270 straddled with ep 119A, which carries the keyhole's secret)
anchors.note: 118A 火事場の段違い平行棒の巻 + 118B アポロンウィンドウの謎の巻 = chs 268 完璧なる友情!! / 269 地獄の三重刑!! / 270 鍵穴の秘密!! — Toei: Terryman revived by the Thunder Sabre saves Kinnikuman from the swords, the Justice Chojin's spirits make Neptuneman doubt his own perfection (= 268), and the episode ends 「ヘルミッショネルズの胸には奇妙なアザが浮かび上がり…」 = the Apollon Window surfacing. ja-WP defines アポロン・ウィンドウ as the keyhole itself (「地面に巨大な鍵穴の形の大穴」), so 118B's title IS ch 270's title (鍵穴の秘密) in the anime's vocabulary; the chapter straddles into 119A, which delivers the solution (C1). A4/A10; medium — the 267/268 and 269/270 split points are derived from the official synopses, not from a per-chapter citation.

THE HONEST TERMINAL (G56). END 273 on three independent sources: (1) ja-WP 夢の超人タッグ編 = 第209話-第273話 and the ep list ends the arc at ep 119, with ep 120 opening the anime-original ザ・サイコー超人の挑戦編; (2) fandom — 119B 光り輝くトロフィー!の巻 vs ch 273 栄光のトロフィー!!の巻 (near-verbatim; the arc page cites ch 273 for 'win the third round when both opponents faint… then continue together to retrieve their trophy'); (3) MangaUpdates' own coverage prose 'Vol 23, Chap 273 (1983 EP 119)'. START 270 under A10 = the second half of the straddled keyhole chapter (Toei: 「テリーマンは…アポロンウィンドウの謎を解明。鍵穴である前方後円墳に鍵を差し込めば…」), then 271 鍵穴をさがせ!! + 272 我が身を捨てて鍵となれ!! in 119A (fandom cites 272 for the Muscle Docking) and 273 in 119B. Volume 23 confirmed by MU AND the fandom volume list AND Shueisha's own vol-23 blurb (夢の超人タッグ編完結!!). START is the medium element; END/volume are high.

continue_points.note: C1 straddle — ep 118B stops as the Apollon Window marks surface on the Hell Missionaries' chests; ep 119A carries the rest of ch 270 (the keyhole's secret). Resume inside ch 270; ep 119 starts there.

C5 — the anime's furthest first-time coverage is ch 273 (栄光のトロフィー!!の巻, vol 23, the last chapter of the Dream Chojin Tag arc). Start reading at ch 274: chs 274-387 (the キン肉星王位争奪編 / Scramble for the Throne, all of vols 24-36) are NEVER adapted by this series — eps 120-137 are two anime-original arcs, and the Throne arc is the separate 1991 anime. MangaUpdates prints the same boundary from the other side: 'Vol 24, Chap 274 (Scramble for the Throne)' as that anime's START. Matches the stored series-level continue_from_chapter = 274 — no change.

annotations.note: Dream-Tag PART 2 (eps 107-119) re-stages the manga's final match inside an anime-original frame: the competitors and crowd warp from Tournament Mountain to a Pyramid Ring that appears in Hokkaido, and Hokkaido then flies into space toward the planet holding the trophy (ja fandom 相違点; Toei ep 119 verbatim 「ピラミッドリングのある北海道は、現在宇宙空間に浮かんでいる」). The match beats themselves are chs 264-273 — MangaUpdates' own note on the pin reads 'Some differences'. Canon with divergent staging (T27/T26), not a retype.

Ch 263 マスク・ジ・エンド!!の巻 straddles the boundary: ep 115B carries the hold and the declaration, ep 116A the peeling and the astonishing face beneath (Toei ep 116). Listed in ep 116's chapters_adapted; it does not move ep 115's stored END (263).

Ch 270 鍵穴の秘密!!の巻 straddles: ep 118B shows the Apollon Window surfacing on the Hell Missionaries' chests, ep 119A gives its secret (the 前方後円墳 keyhole that shuts off Magnet Power). Listed in both rows' chapters_adapted; ep 118's continue sits inside 270 (C1).

repairs.why: Off-by-one-week: our stored date for row 116 is ja-WP's date for episode 115. The stored column duplicates 1985-04-21 on rows 89 AND 90, which shifts rows 90-119 a week early, and it drops the 1985-12-29 airing entirely (rows 120-137 are correct again). Both independent episode lists agree on the ordinal-to-date map: ja-WP 第116話 = 12月8日 (a Sunday, the show's 10:00 Sunday slot); kinnikuman.fandom's list gives 116A/B = December 7, 1985 (that list runs systematically one DAY early throughout — Dec 7 1985 was a Saturday — but its ordinals match). G53-class date defect, not a numbering defect: our 137 rows align 1:1 with ja-WP's 137.
Same one-week shift; ja-WP 第117話 くし刺し! テリーマンの巻 = 12月15日, fandom 117A/B = December 14, 1985.
Same one-week shift; ja-WP 第118話 火事場の段違い平行棒の巻 = 12月22日, fandom 118A/B = December 21, 1985.
The dropped airing. ja-WP 第119話 前方後円墳に鍵をかけろの巻 = 12月29日 (Sunday); fandom 119A/B = December 28, 1985. Row 120 is already correct at 1986-01-05, so the whole shift closes here.

structure.notes:
ROW-COUNT IDENTITY: our 137 rows = ja-WP's 137 = the fandom's 137 broadcasts; the anime is 15-min A/B segments (274 segments) and BOTH lists index segment-wise inside one broadcast row, so the join is by broadcast number + segment titles, merged (ja-WP 第116話 = 見た!キン肉マンの素顔の巻 / ネプチューンキング出現の巻; fandom 116A/116B). The stored ep-115 anchor (115A/115B title identity, batch 17) confirms our row numbers ARE ja-WP's episode numbers.
CHAPTER SPACE: the classic manga's own numbering, chs 1-387 in vols 1-36 (fandom volume list; ja-WP: 夢の超人タッグ編 = 209-273, キン肉星王位争奪編 = 274-387). Vol 22 = 255-263, vol 23 = 264-273 — so target rows 116-119 are exactly volume 23.
WHAT MU COUNTS (G37): MangaUpdates entry 73662729896 is the CONTINUOUS franchise line — its own description says 'The original run in Weekly Shonen Jump from 1979-1986 ended with Vol 36. The series directly continued in 2011 in Weekly Playboy', its status is '93 Volumes (Ongoing)', and its releases number the 2011 週プレ continuation onward from 388 (latest release vol 93 = ch 903-912, which is where latest_known_chapters = 912 comes from). It is NOT the II世/Nisei space and NOT a restart. For chs 1-387 MU's numbering IS our numbering — no conversion — so 'Vol 23, Chap 273' is directly comparable. NOTE a divergence for anyone working past 387: kinnikuman.fandom numbers the 2011 series from 1 on its early volumes (vol 38 = 1-9) while MU numbers it 388+, and the fandom's own later volumes switch to the continuous space (vol 87/88 = 465/475) — irrelevant to this range but a trap for the sequel entries.
WHY THE PIN WAS REFUSED (G36→G56): MU's anime.end text holds THREE Vol/Chap pairs ('Vol 23, Chap 273 (1983 EP 119) Some differences / Vol 36, Chap 387 (Scramble for the Throne) / Vol 45, Chap 465 (Perfect Origin S2)'), and parseCoverageAll only trusts the explicit EP when there is exactly one pair — so the episode defaults to aired_episodes 137, a T6 filler row, and A1 refuses it. MU's chapter IS reached, by ep 119, exactly as MU says: the pin is REDUNDANT, the honest terminal covers it, no suppression needed.
SOURCE COVERAGE LIMITS: kinnikuman.fandom has NO per-episode pages in this range (Episode 115A…120B are all missingtitle; the numbered pages stop in the 50s) and NO 'Chapter N' pages above 121, so there is no per-episode 'Manga counterpart' field and no reverse chapter mapping for 264-273; the Dream Chojin Tag Arc page's citation chain covers only chs 264, 266, 272 and 273 in this stretch (an insource: sweep for 265/267/268/269/270/271 returns nothing). Toei Animation's own lineup pages (lineup.toei-anim.co.jp/ja/tv/kinniku/episode/N/) carry one official synopsis per broadcast — dアニメストア (workId 11253) republishes the identical licensor copy, so treat those two as ONE source, not two.
FILLER TAIL (A1): rows 120-137 take no anchor — ザ・サイコー超人の挑戦編 (120-124) and 地獄の極悪超人編 (125-137) are labelled アニメオリジナル by ja-WP and by the ja fandom, and Toei's synopses for 120/121 (the liner Prince Kinniku-maru, the Psycho Chojin army, the strategist Yama Khan, Carreyas) have no counterpart in chs 274+. T6 stands; nothing in them meets T28.

SPLIT EVIDENCE on the interior boundaries of 264-273. Fixed pins: 264 (ep 116A), 266 (ep 117A), 273 (ep 119B), and the block = vol 23 in full. The 267/268 and 269/270 split points are derived from Toei's official per-episode synopses read against the chapter titles — a ±1 shift is possible (the plausible alternative is 117 = 266-268, 118 = 269-270, 119 = 271-273, which would drop the 270 straddle). The terminal itself (ep 119 → 273, vol 23) is unaffected by either reading.

The batch-20 ask's premise 'the stored last canon anchors are eps 47/48 (119-123)' reads the 21st-Chojin-Olympics CHAPTER range 119-123 as episode numbers — the actual last canon anchor is ep 119 → 273 (manual, Sean sign-off 2026-08-23), which this verdict enriches with START 270, chapters_adapted and volume 23 rather than repairs. The stored 48 → 123 [122] lattice sits in vol 10 and does not bear on the terminal; nothing found in this pass contradicts it.

Ep 116's START = 263 rests on Toei's synopsis treating the Mask The End peeling as ep 116's own opening content rather than the narrated recap ja-WP says every A-part carries (「各話Aパートの冒頭では、中野さんが前回のあらすじを解説していた」). If you read that opening as re-shown pages, ep 116 becomes START 264 and the eps 115/116 partial{263} annotation should be dropped.
